title: Crown of Brine: Reborn crashes on Android during the lighthouse arc

posts.cooked:
Hey everyone, I’ve been playing Crown of Brine: Reborn on my Android phone and I keep running into the same issue during the lighthouse arc. The game crashes every time I try to enter the lighthouse area. It’s pretty frustrating because I was really looking forward to this part of the story. I’m on the latest version of the remaster and my device meets all the requirements, so I’m not sure what’s causing it.

Has anyone else experienced this crash? I’ve tried restarting the game and even reinstalling it, but no luck so far. It seems like the crash happens right after the tidal waves sequence when the screen starts to shift colors and the music changes. I’m guessing it might have something to do with the tide-engine’s lighting effects in that area? Would love to hear if the devs are aware and if there’s any patch planned.

If anyone has found a workaround or a fix, please share! I’m eager to get past this part and back to exploring the mysterious depths. Hopefully, we can get this sorted out soon, the lighthouse arc is looking amazing despite the hiccup.

posts.cooked:
Hey, I ran into the same issue during the lighthouse arc on my Android device. The game just freezes and then crashes without any error message. I think it might have something to do with the Tide-Engine struggling with the dynamic lighting effects around the lighthouse because it’s the only spot where I noticed noticeable lag before the crash.

One thing I tried that helped temporarily was lowering the graphical settings to the minimum before entering that area. It’s not a permanent fix, but it got me past the crash for now. Hopefully, the devs can patch this soon because the remaster looks amazing otherwise, and I really want to experience the rest of the story without interruptions.

Has anyone figured out if this happens on specific Android versions or devices? Sharing that info might help narrow down the cause. Fingers crossed for an update that stabilizes the game!

posts.cooked:
Hey, I ran into the same issue during the lighthouse arc on my Android device. The game crashes right when the scene tries to load the giant tidal storm outside, which is super frustrating because that part is such a highlight in the story. It seems tied to the Tide-Engine’s weather effects not playing nicely on some Android hardware.

A bit of a workaround I found is to lower the graphics settings before entering the lighthouse area—turning off dynamic weather and shadows helped me get past the crash point. Not perfect, but at least it lets me keep going without the app closing every few minutes. Hopefully, the devs patch this soon because the remaster looks amazing otherwise.

If anyone has a more permanent fix or even a save file just before the lighthouse arc that works smoothly, I’d love to try that too. Fingers crossed for an update soon!

posts.cooked:
Hey, I ran into the exact same crash on my phone during the lighthouse section in Crown of Brine: Reborn. The game just freezes and then closes out, no error message or anything. It’s super frustrating because I was really digging the remaster—especially how the tide-engine improved the lighting effects in that part.

I’ve noticed it seems to happen right when the storm picks up and there’s that sequence where the water levels shift dynamically. From what I’ve gathered in the forums, it might be tied to the new particle effects or the way the tide-engine handles those transitions on certain Android devices. I tried lowering the graphics settings and clearing cache, but no luck so far.

If you haven’t already, it might be worth sending a bug report through the in-game menu with your device specs. Hopefully, the devs catch it soon because the rest of the arc is great and I’m looking forward to seeing how the remaster polishes the later chapters. Fingers crossed for a patch!
